runner_classes.ubuntu-24.04: The source-scaled SPEC §9 limits below apply on hosted x64 Linux, without host-specific slack.
runner_classes.ubuntu-24.04-arm: Same limits on hosted arm64 Linux; architecture is not grounds for widening.
runner_classes.macos-14: SPEC §9 M-series reference class with the source-size derivation below.
runner_classes.windows-latest: Same end-to-end limits on hosted x64 Windows, including process startup.
runner_classes.windows-11-arm: Same limits on hosted arm64 Windows, including process startup.
runner_classes.macos-15-intel: Same derived limits on hosted x64 macOS; architecture is not grounds for widening.

reasons.keyword_p50_ms: SPEC §9 warm keyword p50 <=40 ms; all search shapes, including counts and compact rendering, finish the full process.
reasons.keyword_p95_ms: SPEC §9 warm keyword p95 <=80 ms; 20 samples minimum, none discarded.
reasons.recall_ms: SPEC §9 recall <=250 ms warm; pack shares its retrieval/window budget.
reasons.census_ms: SPEC §9 no-change census <=15 ms, measured conservatively through full index command exit.
reasons.incremental_ms: SPEC §9 one-session incremental refresh <=50 ms through full index command exit.
reasons.first_index_ms: SPEC §9 full-history index target 60000 ms; applied limit scales by measured source bytes. Example: 124500000 bytes gives 60000 × 124500000 / 886000000 = 8431.15 ms.
reasons.dense_index_ms: SPEC §9 60000 ms full-history index deadline with 2x headroom, then scaled by measured source bytes: 30000 × min(1, source_bytes / 886000000).
reasons.dense_p50_ms: SPEC §9 requires 2x headroom for 2M scale workloads: half the 40 ms keyword p50 deadline.
reasons.dense_p95_ms: SPEC §9 requires 2x headroom for 2M scale workloads: half the 80 ms keyword p95 deadline.
reasons.hybrid_p50_ms: 1000 semantic rows versus SPEC §5/9 173524 rows: fixed query embedding 107 ms (SPEC §5 warm CPU measurement) + variable retrieval allowance (200 - 107) × 1000 / 173524 = 107.536 ms. This gate does not claim target-scale vector-scan validation.
reasons.hybrid_first_ms: 1000 semantic rows: fixed cold query embedding 323 ms (SPEC §5 CPU measurement) + (1000 - 323) × 1000 / 173524 = 326.901 ms; the first query must include meaning results.
reasons.source_scaling: SPEC §9 refers to 886,000,000 source bytes. For mixed and dense first-index, census, incremental, navigation, recall and mixed keyword cases, applied limit = listed real-history limit × min(1, measured source_bytes / 886000000). The measured byte count is mandatory; the 100k mixed corpus is not treated as full history. Dense keyword has 2M rows, exceeds the real row count, and retains the 2x-headroom limits.
